title: Mute Toogle
description: Mute or unmute all game sounds instantly with one key press. Easy on/off toggle with message!
body:
Mute Toggle is a simple Minecraft mod that lets you mute or unmute all game sounds with one key

Press the M key (default) to toggle sound ON or OFF. A message will show to let you know if it’s muted or not

It mutes everything: music, blocks, mobs, weather, etc...

Even though the key only works in-game, the sound stays muted or unmuted in menus after you use it

No new buttons or settings. Just one keybind (set in Controls) to quickly switch sound on or off.

Great if you want instant silence while playing (or switching apps)
